intent: Find the places tagged birds use along their flyway: where they land, linger and gather, and how wind may carry their movement, and name those places from map evidence.

inputs.meaning: GPS tags on birds report a position about every minute. Birds land and linger at places they use (water, roosts, feeding grounds), then fly between them fast and in fairly straight lines.
Surface wind over the area: speed and the direction it comes from. Wind may carry where birds drift.

fields.name: wind_direction_10m
fields.description: compass degrees the wind comes from
